controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : la fusion Norfolk Southern / Union Pacific requiert l'approbation du STB, et le 10-K reconnait que toute consolidation ferroviaire pourrait affecter l'environnement reglementaire et concurrentiel
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "CSXT's primary rail competitor is Norfolk Southern Railway, which operates throughout much of the Company's territory. During 2025, Norfolk Southern Railway entered into an agreement to merge with Union Pacific Railroad to form the nation's only transcontinental rail network, which requires the approval of the Surface Transportation Board." Facteur de risque : "Additionally, any currently proposed or other future consolidation in the rail industry could materially affect the regulatory and competitive environment in which the Company operates."

controles.affirmation: 10-Q T2 2026 : honoraires de conseil lies a la consolidation sectorielle
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "advisory expenses related to potential industry consolidation. These increases were partially offset by an insurance recovery related to 2024 property damage on the Blue Ridge subdivision"

controles.affirmation: Facteur de risque charbon : baisse de la production electrique au charbon sur le territoire CSX
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "changing dynamics in the U.S. and global energy markets, including the impacts of regulation and alternative fuel sources, have resulted in lower energy production from coal-fired power plants in CSX's service territory." 10-Q T2 2026 : "Domestic coal decreased due to lower shipments to utility plants..."

controles.affirmation: Autorisation de rachat de 5 Mds$ le 12 mai 2026, s'ajoutant a 989 M$ restants
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K 14/05/2026 : "On May 12, 2026, the Board of Directors authorized a new share repurchase program, providing $5 billion of incremental authority to the approximately $989 million remaining under the existing share repurchase program as of March 31, 2026."

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : ratio d'exploitation 67,9% en 2025 contre 63,9% en 2024 et 62,5% en 2023 (540 pb)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, comptes de resultat : CA 14 657 / 14 540 / 14 092 M$ et charges totales 9 158 / 9 295 / 9 571 M$ (2023/2024/2025). Recalcul : 62,48% / 63,93% / 67,92%, soit 544 pb de degradation. 10-Q T2 2026 : "Operating margin of 38.3% improved 240 basis points versus the prior year"
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q ecrit "Operating margin of 38.3%" en phrase et non "Operating Margin 38.3 %" en ligne de tableau : ajuster la forme de la citation, le chiffre est exact.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : dette brute 18,9 Mds$ au 30 juin 2026 (17 162 + 1 702) contre 14 088 M$ de capitaux propres ; interets 844 M$ = 18,7% du resultat d'exploitation 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, bilan au 30/06/2026 : Long-term Debt 17 162, part courante 1 702, Total Shareholders' Equity 14 088. 10-K FY2025 : charge d'interets 844 M$ ; resultat d'exploitation 2025 = 14 092 - 9 571 = 4 521 M$ ; 844/4 521 = 18,7%. 8-K 23/10/2025 : "completed a public offering of $300,000,000 aggregate principal amount of the Company's 5.050% Notes due 2035"
